what: A 6px dot follows the cursor late by .25s with power3 (difference blending, so it is visible on both light and dark surfaces) and grows 3x over .25s power2.out above links·buttons·inputs. It turns on over .2s at the first move and turns off when leaving the window. Given a label, only inside that panel (the hero) the dot is replaced by an 82px-diameter blurred glass bubble with text (SCROLL) that follows the cursor, and it returns to a dot when leaving the panel

options.label: When given, a bubble holding this letter floats inside that plate (dots hidden)
options.grow-dur: Grow and shrink duration (s), default .25 — reference site .6
options.grow-ease: Growing curve, default power2.out — Brand uses power3
options.look: ”solid” — a single-color --fx-dot dot (default accent color) with no difference blending, size --fx-dot-size (default 15px) · tint — a 10% ink-black dot with no difference blending (--fx-dot-size, default 10px) that turns 20% accent color while enlarged (data-hot) (color change lengths --fx-in-dur .3s · --fx-out-dur .55s) · rect — keeps difference blending, a white rectangle with no rounded corners (--fx-dot-w × --fx-dot-h, default 28×18 · color --fx-dot, default --kf-ink) — the size of the arrow cursor plate over the Brand still-image transition cell
options.--fx-dot-size: look: solid dot diameter (css, on :root or body), default 15px · the default type (difference-blend dot) follows this value too, default 6px — a reference site uses 10px
options.lerp: Instead of delay (dur), it follows each frame by this share of the remaining distance — original .15. If absent, the dur delay applies
options.out-dur · out-ease: Only shrinking uses a different length and curve (growing uses grow-dur · grow-ease) — Brand grow .3 cubic-bezier(.43,.05,.17,1), shrink .55 cubic-bezier(.18,.06,.23,1)
options.hot: Where it grows (CSS selector), default a · button · input fields · label · summary · role=button·tabindex — for Brand it is ”a, button, [data-pointer-target]”

note: Nothing is attached on touch devices

from.where: All sections: cursor dot (.cursor-dot) and hero SCROLL bubble (.hero-cursor-scroll)
